summary: First full test iteration for TruckNav Pro (Expo + FastAPI). Backend: 23/23 pytest cases passed covering auth (register/login/me/401), vehicles CRUD + auto-active + validation + activate switch, tacho manual events, GPS auto event creation on state change + idempotent no-change, event confirmation with state correction, card-sim bulk confirm of last-24h, routes/calculate (truck adjustment + hazmat warnings). Frontend (mobile web 390x844): register -> dashboard, state buttons (DRIVING/REST), card-sim, vehicle form save (bus/hazmat), logbook (Historial) rendering with log-row entries incl. 'Corregido manualmente', map (Ruta) placeholder with dest-input + Nominatim search enabling calc-route-btn, logout + driver@test.com re-login. No red screens, no console errors. No deprecated Expo packages detected (no expo-av/barcode-scanner/background-fetch).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py file is ~650 lines; still within acceptable range but close to the 700 line threshold - consider splitting routers (auth, vehicles, tacho, routes) soon.
GET /api/tacho/status returns current_state='REST' when no events exist; acceptable but consider explicit 'UNKNOWN' state.
Nominatim is called directly from the client (/map.tsx) without a UA/custom header; respect their usage policy and add attribution. Not a blocker.
seed_data_creation: Each pytest run creates one TEST_ user and a few vehicles under it (prefixed test_user_<uuid>@test.com). UI test created an extra 'UI Bus 1' vehicle under a disposable user. No modification of driver@test.com data besides adding a couple of tacho events during UI run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest config in /app/backend/pytest.ini uses xdist by default - run with `-p no:xdist -o addopts=''` to avoid session-fixture duplication across workers for sequential tests that assume shared state. Backend URL env var is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Tab labels in Spanish: Tacógrafo / Ruta / Vehículo / Historial.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no bugs found in this iteration.
